subject: Social Media
title: Social Currency
description: A quick, practical guide to Social Currency.

hook.text: You share a clever article not because it's useful—but because sharing it makes you look smart.

buildup.text: Jonah Berger calls this social currency. We share things that make us appear knowledgeable or cool.

discovery.text: Secret menus, insider knowledge, exclusive access—these spread because possessing them signals status.

twist.text: Social currency explains why false but surprising 'facts' spread faster than boring truths.

climax.text: People don't share information. They share identity. Every post says: 'This is who I am.'

punchline.text: You don't share for them. You share for you.

quiz.question: What is 'social currency' in sharing behavior?
options: Sharing content that makes you look good
